name: 7 dnej leta
source:
The protagonist of "7 dnej leta" is a young man, having a closed life. But everything changes in the evening of New Year's Eve when he decided to go on business, but turned up in Everlasting Summer's reader known summer camp.

At first glance, the story is the same: bus, summer camp, girls... However, little differences accumulate to become a whole new history.  The main character (more exactly - characters) plays an important role too: he is different to normal Semyon, that's why he has a different story.

By the way, there are rumors saying that our character is not just a normal pioneer...

It is available to walk through every Everlasting Summer's main heroine route (Lena, Miku, Alice, Slavya and Ulyana) and also featuring Olga's new one.

[From Steam Workshop]
translation:
《七日夏》主人公是一名生活封闭的年轻人。然而，新年前夕晚上，他决定出门办事，却进入了《永恒之夏》读者熟悉的夏令营世界。

乍看之下，故事相同：公交车、夏令营、女孩……但细微差异逐渐累积，最终变成全新故事。主角（更准确地说，是主角们）也发挥重要作用：他与普通谢苗不同，因此拥有不同故事。

顺便一提，有传言说我们的角色并不是普通先驱者……

可以体验《永恒之夏》所有主要女主角路线（莉娜、美树、爱丽丝、斯拉维娅和乌里扬娜），还新增奥尔加路线。

[来源：Steam创意工坊]
